newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady as cargoes to U.S. counte.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady as cargoes to U.S. counte.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady to slightly lower in quiet activity, but a recent spate of exports to the U.S. gave some hope to the bulls.
At least 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes of premium unleaded and regular unleaded were shipped from Northwest Europe to the U.S. in the second half of April, traders said.

The outlook for May was unclear, however, and hinged on whether the arbitrage stayed open and whether U.S. demand kicked in ahead of the summer driving season amid lower primary inventories, they said.
Eurograde barges ended down $1 at $196/$198 and cargoes were notionally valued at $201/$205 cif.
Holidays across Europe kept trading to a minimum.
